審稿人建議以第二套獨立的模擬程式重做光收集模擬。我們認真考慮過這項建議,最後決定不在本文中採納,理由如下:

已完成。圖 7 橫軸單位原誤標為 ns,現已更正為 ps,數值未變。感謝審稿人細心指出。

**Response to the referee: Manuscript SYN-2026-0219**
"Precision measurement of the cosmic-ray proton flux from 1 GV to 1.8 TV with the SYN-Spec space spectrometer"

We thank the referee for the careful reading and for the three comments. We have addressed each of them in the revised manuscript. Our replies follow, with the referee's comments in italics.

**R1 (geomagnetic cutoff).** *The systematic uncertainty from the geomagnetic cutoff safety factor is not given. Please vary the factor (nominal 1.2) and include the effect in the systematics.*

We agree. We repeated the analysis with the safety factor varied from its nominal value of 1.2 to 1.0 and to 1.4. The resulting change in the flux is at most 1.1% below 30 GV and less than 0.1% above 30 GV. We added a paragraph describing this study in Sec. 5.4 and a corresponding row in Table 4. We also included the effect in the systematic uncertainties.

**R2 (data availability).** *Please provide the flux values in all rigidity bins as a table.*

We added Supplementary Table S2. It lists the proton flux with its statistical and systematic uncertainties in all 45 rigidity bins from 1 GV to 1800 GV.

**R3 (livetime).** *Eq. (3) defines the livetime fraction with the dead time in the numerator; this appears to be a typo. Please correct it and confirm the results are unaffected.*

The referee is correct. We corrected Eq. (3) to livetime fraction = 1 − (dead time / total time). The error was only in the printed equation. The analysis code already used the correct definition. To confirm this, we reran the full analysis on 2026-10-22. It reproduced all flux values identically to four significant digits, so no result changes.

All changes are in the revised manuscript. We thank the referee again for the comments, which improved the paper.

Sincerely,
[author names / corresponding author]

**Response to the referee**

Manuscript SYN-NIM-2026-0733, "A track-based in-situ calibration method for a sampling electromagnetic calorimeter"

Dear Referee,

Thank you for your comments. Two of them need data we have not yet taken or a reprocessing that is still running, so this reply reports what is done and what is scheduled.

**R1 (second energy point).** *Not yet done.* We agree that validation at a second beam energy would strengthen the paper. No data at a second energy exist yet. A 100 GeV beam period is scheduled for 16–18 November 2026. We will analyse it with the same procedure as the 50 GeV sample and expect results around 25 November 2026. We will then add them to the validation section.

**R2 (temperature).** *Done.* We added Sec. 5.3 and Table 4, which describe the temperature dependence of the response. We measured a temperature coefficient of −0.21%/K. Over the ±1.5 K operating range this gives a 0.3% systematic uncertainty on the energy scale. We included it in Table 5, where the total energy-scale systematic changes from 0.8% to 0.85%.

**R3 (fit model).** *Not yet done.* The comparison needs the 50 GeV sample reprocessed with the new ntuple version. That job is queued and we expect it to finish around 10 November 2026. We will then fit with both the Gaussian-core and the Gaussian-plus-exponential-tail models and quote the difference in the resolution parameters.

**R4 (consistency).** *Not yet resolved.* Thank you for spotting this. The abstract (9.8%/√E) and Table 3 ((10.4 ± 0.3)%/√E) still disagree in our current draft. We are tracing which value comes from the final fit and will make the abstract, Table 3 and the text agree.

We would like to resubmit the R2 and R4 changes now, and to send the R1 and R3 results as soon as they are available (about 25 November). If the editor prefers to receive the complete revision at once, we can wait until then.

Sincerely,
[Authors]

# Response to the Referee

**Manuscript:** "Measurement of the inclusive Λc+ production cross section in pp collisions at √s = 13.6 TeV with the XYZ detector"
**Manuscript ID:** SYN-2026-0412
**Date:** [DATE OF SUBMISSION]

Dear Editor and Referee,

We thank the referee for the careful reading and the constructive comments. One of the three comments (R3) is fully addressed in the revised manuscript. The other two (R1, R2) require a rerun of the full analysis chain that has not yet finished, so they are not addressed in this submission. Below we state for each comment what has been done and what is still pending.

**R1 (pileup systematic).** *The pileup-reweighting uncertainty is not evaluated. Please vary σ_MB by ±4.6%, propagate the effect to the cross section, and list it in Table 3.*

**Status: pending. Not yet included in the revised manuscript.** We agree that this uncertainty must be evaluated. The rerun of the full analysis chain with σ_MB varied by ±4.6% was submitted to the grid on 2026-10-28. The output is expected on 2026-11-12. No result exists yet, so Table 3 has no pileup row, and its total systematic uncertainty (6.1%) is unchanged. Once the rerun finishes, we will add the pileup uncertainty as a new row in Table 3 and update the total. The effect of the ±4.6% variation on the cross section will be [VALUE NEEDED: pileup uncertainty, X.XXX%]. The updated total systematic uncertainty will be [VALUE NEEDED: total systematic, X.XXX%].

**R2 (unfolding closure).** *Please provide a closure test of the Bayesian unfolding using an alternative (flat) prior, and quote the resulting uncertainty.*

**Status: pending. Not yet included in the revised manuscript.** We agree and will perform this test. The flat-prior unfolding requires the new response matrix produced by the R1 rerun, so it cannot start before 2026-11-12. We estimate completion by 2026-11-19. We will then report the closure result and the resulting uncertainty, [VALUE NEEDED: flat-prior unfolding uncertainty, X.XXX%], and state where it appears in the manuscript.

**R3 (trigger efficiency).** *The definition of the trigger efficiency in Sec. 4.2 is ambiguous (per event or per candidate?). Please clarify and state the value used.*

**Status: done.** We rewrote Sec. 4.2 (lines 212–230 of the revised manuscript). The trigger efficiency is now defined **per event**, in the new Eq. (7). The value used is ε_trig = 0.962 ± 0.004 (stat) ± 0.006 (syst), and it is now listed in Table 2.

**Timeline.** R1 and R2 cannot be completed by the requested date of 2026-11-05. We expect the R1 results on 2026-11-12 and the R2 results on 2026-11-19. We therefore request an extension to [REQUESTED DATE, e.g. 2026-11-26], so that we can submit a revision that addresses all three comments. If the editor prefers, we can submit the current revision, which addresses R3 only, now.

Sincerely,
[AUTHOR NAMES], on behalf of the authors

**主旨：** 稿件 SYN-PH-2026-118 審稿回覆（部分修訂）與延期申請

敬愛的編輯與審稿人：

感謝您們對拙稿〈輕子親和 Z′ 模型於 LHC 雙輕子通道之現象學研究〉（SYN-PH-2026-118）的審閱與寶貴意見。目前 R3、R4 已完成修訂，R1、R2 的計算尚未完成。依貴刊 2026-11-03 的期限，我們無法提交完整的修訂稿，在此說明各項進度，並申請延期。

**R3（符號慣例）——已完成。**
第 2.3 節式 (12) 已改為與式 (4) 一致的慣例（g_ℓ → −g_ℓ）。我們於 2026-10-25 對三個基準點 BP1–BP3 重新做了數值檢查，截面不變（相對差異 < 10⁻⁶）。

**R4（文獻）——已完成。**
已在第 1 節第二段補入近年同類 Z′ 現象學研究，即參考文獻 [31]–[33]。

**R1（NLO QCD 修正）——進行中。**
NLO 計算目前正在批次執行，預計 2026-11-20 完成。目前稿中所有截面仍為 LO，尚無 K 因子數值。計算完成後，我們會在稿中加入 NLO QCD 修正（K 因子），並說明它對排除範圍的影響。

**R2（以 139 fb⁻¹ 資料重鑄）——進行中，並有一項待解問題。**
重鑄需使用 R1 的 NLO 截面，因此要等 R1 完成後才能進行，預計 2026-11-27 完成。此外，我們的重鑄效率映射在驗證時與參考結果相差 18%，原因仍在調查，尚未通過驗證。在這項驗證通過之前，我們不會報告更新後的排除下限。

**目前稿中的排除下限。**
稿中現有的 m_Z′ > 2.4 TeV（95% CL）是 LO 截面加舊版重鑄的結果。它尚未反映 NLO 修正，也未使用 139 fb⁻¹ 資料重新重鑄。在 R1、R2 完成前，請審稿人將此數值視為暫定。

**延期申請。**
我們懇請將修訂稿與完整回覆的提交期限延至 [2026-12-04]。我們會在 R1、R2 完成後，一併提交包含 NLO 結果、更新重鑄與排除下限的完整修訂稿，以及逐條回覆。

再次感謝您們的耐心與審閱。

敬祝 順心

[作者姓名]
[單位／聯絡方式]
